hero.kicker: Discovering the extraordinary within the living world
hero.title: The Living Canvas
hero.subtitle: Exploring Life Through Science and Art
text: An interdisciplinary exhibition and competition celebrating the intersection of life sciences, visual arts and human curiosity.

From the intricate architecture of a single cell to the extraordinary complexity of the human brain, The Living Canvas reveals the beauty of life through the eyes of scientists, researchers and artists.

intro.headline: Where Scientific Discovery Becomes Art
intro.lead: Science allows us to understand life. Art allows us to experience it differently.
paragraphs: The Living Canvas brings these two disciplines together through a curated collection of scientific photography, microscopic imagery, research videos, illustrations and visual interpretations of the living world.

By presenting scientific discoveries through an artistic lens, we invite audiences to explore the extraordinary patterns, structures and processes that shape life — many of which remain invisible to the naked eye.
The Living Canvas is a space for discovery, creativity and dialogue between scientists, artists, students and the wider community.

closing.headline: Every Discovery Has a Story
paragraphs: Behind every scientific image is a question, an experiment and a moment of discovery.
Explore the stories behind our collection, meet the researchers who created these works, and discover how science continues to transform our understanding of life.
Whether you are a scientist, artist, student or simply curious about the world around you, we invite you to see life from a different perspective.
